title: subscribeQuery
subtitle: Subscribe to query state changes
description: Subscribe to query state changes programmatically. Useful for non-React code, event handlers, and custom state management.

rows.name: queryKey
rows.description: Unique identifier for the query. Can be a string or array of primitives.

rows.name: callback
rows.description: Function called whenever the query state changes.

rows.name: options
rows.description: Optional configuration object. If no fetcher is provided, uses a previously registered fetcher.

returns.description: Unsubscribe function to stop listening to state changes

dos: Always call the unsubscribe function for cleanup
